answer.says: Ramesh, the chai can wait. I am finishing this paragraph. The tension between the particular needs of the household and the abstract oversight of the state is not yet resolved in my mind, and it is the very skeleton of what I must write to Lindner.
answer.thought: The morning light is turning the dust motes in the study into a slow, golden suspension. I am finishing the paragraph on the ethical substance of the state, trying to hold the concrete and the abstract together without letting the former swallow the latter. The plan says I should have walked to Lodhi Gardens by now, but the thought is not yet ripe for the open air; it needs the confinement of the study to take shape.
